2610.08033.title: Learning in Dreams, Winning in Reality: A Continuous Dyna Loop for a Ten-Hero MOBA
2610.08033.paper_summary: World models are usually judged from the inside: by prediction loss, by the return a policy earns in imagination, or by how convincing their frames look. We judge one from the outside. We learn a structured, multi-agent world model of a complete ten-hero MOBA (206 units, every hero acting every tick, games of up to 6,000 ticks), train a policy only inside it with 1,400-tick free-running imagined episodes, and measure that policy in the real game against the opponent the game ships with. The real game never provides a gradient; it provides the policy's own games as training data for the world model, and an online evaluation that selects and anchors the policy. Run as a continuous asynchronous Dyna loop, the policy wins 70.2% of real games as radiant (421 of 600; 95% CI 66.4-73.7) on seeds never used for any decision, up from 0% for dream training alone and 33.7% before the loop. It wins none as dire, and neither does the shipped opponent when it plays itself. Four findings explain the result. Model exploitation is invisible from inside the dream: every unanchored run collapsed within a few updates while no in-dream metric tracked the collapse. A world model that is accurate on its training corpus is badly wrong on the policy's own games, and Dyna repairs it there, which is worth +9.2 points of real win rate with the policy recipe held fixed. Finally, the policy inherits its world model's fidelity profile mechanic by mechanic: the model represents the macro game but not crowd control, cast timing or lethality, and the policy wins by map-wide pressure with almost no coordinated fighting. We release the world model, the dream-PPO harness, a world-model debugger, the evaluation protocol, and every policy and log.
2610.08033.paper_summary_zh: 世界模型通常是從內部來評估的：通過預測損失、通過策略在想像中獲得的回報，或通過它們的框架看起來有多令人信服。我們則是從外部來評估。我們學習了一個結構化的多代理世界模型，涵蓋了一個完整的十英雄MOBA（206個單位，每個英雄每個時刻都在行動，遊戲長達6,000個時刻），僅在其中訓練一個策略，使用1,400個時刻的自由運行想像劇集，並在真實遊戲中對抗遊戲隨附的對手來測量該策略。真實遊戲從不提供梯度；它提供策略自己的遊戲作為世界模型的訓練數據，以及一個在線評估，來選擇和固定策略。作為一個持續的異步Dyna循環運行，該策略在真實遊戲中作為輻射方贏得了70.2%的勝率（421場中的600場；95% CI 66.4-73.7），這些種子從未用於任何決策，這比僅進行夢想訓練的0%和循環前的33.7%有所提升。它在黑暗方中沒有贏得任何比賽，隨附的對手在自我對戰時也沒有贏得任何比賽。四個發現解釋了這一結果。模型的利用在夢中是不可見的：每次未固定的運行在幾次更新內都崩潰，而沒有任何夢中指標追蹤崩潰。一個在其訓練語料庫上準確的世界模型在策略自己的遊戲中卻是錯誤的，而Dyna在那裡修復了它，這在固定策略配方的情況下，真實勝率提高了+9.2個百分點。最後，該策略按機械逐一繼承其世界模型的忠實度特徵：該模型代表宏觀遊戲，但不包括人群控制、施法時機或致命性，該策略通過幾乎沒有協調的戰鬥來獲得全圖壓力的勝利。我們發布了世界模型、夢想PPO工具、世界模型調試器、評估協議，以及每個策略和日誌。
2610.08033.author: Jordy Kieto et.al.
